rows.en:
Ugh…

Where am I?

Right… That alien got me, and I passed out. All right!
…!? Ugh… ugh… H-Hayata!
Cap, it's Ultraman!
Shwatch!!
Ultraman… where is he going?

"Alien Baltan's spaceship must be around here somewhere!

…!?

There!"
He did it! Ultraman's finishing ray blew up Alien Baltan's spaceship!
Hmm, just as I thought…
That was the Specium Ray, wasn't it, Cap! …Oh, look at the radar. Reinforcements from the TDF have arrived!
…The invaders' threat had passed. But for one unfortunate man, it was only the beginning of a long night.

15,803 sheep, 15,804 sheep, 15,805 sheep…

Sigh… We rescued Dr. Namikawa safe and sound, and this mission was a huge success too.

Can't somebody take out Arashi's snoring with the Specium Ray as well? Haaah, good grief…
Defeat Baseball Mask!
Defeat Baseball Mask, Locomotive Mask and all Zolder Soldiers! Also seize the laboratory and the factory!
Defeat Space Ninja Alien Baltan and all enemies! Also seize the laboratory, the factory and the power plant!
Defeat Baseball Mask, Locomotive Mask and all Zolder Soldiers! Also seize the laboratory, the factory and the power plant!
One night, a red mist descended upon Tokyo. In that mist, people collapsed one after another, their faces twisted in agony… The Unicorn Agency immediately began investigating this anomaly.
As a result, a lethal dose of toxin was detected among the mist's components, and it was further revealed that the mist itself had fallen from space.
On receiving this report, the Science Patrol sent out two members, Ide and Arashi, wearing special protective suits, to patrol the city…

Then…

the Unicorn Agency's view is that this mist, which we took for a massive fall of space dust, is no mere natural phenomenon?

Yes…

At this rate, all of Tokyo will become a city of the dead within a few hours…
Hmm…
Yes, this is HQ.
This is Arashi… I spotted an alien-looking creature near Fifth Street. I fired the Spider at it, and it vanished.
It vanished!? Arashi, why did you shoot?
W-well… uh…
Don't blame that man. The fault was mine.
Wawawa, it's heeere!?
Who!? Who are you?
Hahaha… Please don't look at me with such frightening faces. As you've guessed, I am an alien…
An alien?
Indeed… I am an Alien Zarab, from within the 8th galaxy.
Zarab…?

Yes… In our language it means "brother".

Living together in peace and harmony is our motto!

So… you people of Earth and I are brothers, too. Though I am the elder brother, and you are still young little brothers.
How is it you can talk with us?

Ah, forgive me…

I am sending my thoughts into those electronic brains of yours! Otherwise we could not talk.
Your purpose in coming to Earth?
You will understand soon enough…
Captain Muramatsu, it's him! I'm sure… he's the one who made this mist fall!
I told you Earth is our brother. Do you think a brother would do something so cruel? Hahaha…
That's a lie! Captain Muramatsu, don't be fooled!
It seems you don't trust me. What must I do for you to believe me? Brother…

Alien Zarab…

Earlier, you called us young little brothers. Does that mean you're superior to us in every respect?
Exactly so…
Then… can you clear away this mist that's tormenting us?
Hmm… If I can, will you trust me?

Mm, we'll trust you…

Ide, Arashi… I'm counting on you to look after Alien Zarab. Have him clear away this mist!
Roger.

Brain!

No, Mister Brain… Why do you let this thug Gomez do as he pleases?
My dear Hustler… are you asking me a question?
No… no, I mean…
No one may question me… I ask the questions! You give the answers!
Understood…

Then let me ask…

What is the status of the iron giant Calamity, which BF stole from the Republic of Merca?

You mean the military robot built by analyzing Giant Robo, the pride of Unicorn's Japan Branch?

It's said to have the same abilities as Giant Robo, and to be armed with mini missiles made from modified special bombs…

…!?

I see it now! Mister Brain!

It's a plan to use that military robot to defeat One-Seven, isn't it?
I see, how interesting… We of the Sabotage Squad will hitch a ride on that as well!
That's a brilliant idea I came up with just now! You mean to interfere?
Why would I interfere? We're fighting a common enemy! Mister Brain, what do you say?
Permission granted, Captain Gomez!

I'm honored!

Chief, begin preparations!
My dear Hustler… you will support BF with the repaired Roller Robot and Hurricane Robot.
Tch… Understood, Mister Brain.
Alien Zarab, was it? Can you really clear away this mist?
Have no fear, brother…
Cap… the mist is clearing.
Well, if that don't beat all…
Wh-what's that!?
What is it? What happened?
Giant Robo has appeared! We didn't notice until now, but with the mist clearing, it's…
What about it?
Something seems off about it.
That's strange… I don't remember calling Robo… Could it be!? Calamity?

In any case… Alien Zarab, we welcome you as a friend!

Arashi, Ide… return to HQ and show him to a guest room. He's a guest from space, so mind your manners.
Thank you, brother…

Roger, roger!!

Come, come… you must be tired from your long journey through space. Please get some good rest today. I'll show you the way.
Uwaaah!?
Wh-wh-what!?
Fufufu… How do you feel? Arashi, Ide… You'll cooperate with me, won't you?
Yes…
I will do as you say…
Then… you'll take me to Science Patrol HQ…

uncertain: U04898: Ultraman's 『』 inner voice rendered in double quotes.
U04905-U04907: confirm the earlier guess for garbled conditions (研究所、工場 = laboratory, factory).
U04945: メルカ共和国 romanized 'Republic of Merca'.
U04943: 私に質問は許されない read as 'No one may question me'.
U04948: 名事 read as 名案 (brilliant idea); same reading applied to B0056 U04492.
